title: After Training
statementMd:
After a team finished their training session on Euro football championship, Valeric was commissioned to gather the balls and sort them into baskets. Overall the stadium has $*n*$ balls and $*m*$ baskets. The baskets are positioned in a row from left to right and they are numbered with numbers from $1$ to $*m*$, correspondingly. The balls are numbered with numbers from $1$ to $*n*$.

Valeric decided to sort the balls in the order of increasing of their numbers by the following scheme. He will put each new ball in the basket with the least number of balls. And if he's got several variants, he chooses the basket which stands closer to the middle. That means that he chooses the basket for which ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/f9d0b92b5db1d7995ab93882f3948ffd8b213597.png) is minimum, where $*i*$ is the number of the basket. If in this case Valeric still has multiple variants, he chooses the basket with the minimum number.

For every ball print the number of the basket where it will go according to Valeric's scheme.

Note that the balls are sorted into baskets in the order of increasing numbers, that is, the first ball goes first, then goes the second ball and so on.

## Input

The first line contains two space-separated integers $*n*$, $*m*$ $(1 ≤ *n*, *m* ≤ 10^{5})$ — the number of balls and baskets, correspondingly.

## Output

Print $*n*$ numbers, one per line. The $*i*$-th line must contain the number of the basket for the $*i*$-th ball.
statementZhMd:
训练结束后，一支球队完成了欧洲足球锦标赛的训练，Valeric 受委托收集足球并将它们分类放入篮子中。体育场内共有 $*n*$ 个足球和 $*m*$ 个篮子。篮子从左到右排成一行，并分别编号为 $1$ 到 $*m*$。足球编号为 $1$ 到 $*n*$。

Valeric 决定按照编号递增的顺序，使用以下方案对足球进行分类。他会将每个新足球放入当前足球数量最少的篮子中。如果有多个选择，他会选择距离中间位置更近的篮子。也就是说，他会选择使 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/f9d0b92b5db1d7995ab93882f3948ffd8b213597.png) 最小的篮子，其中 $*i*$ 是篮子的编号。如果在这种情况下仍有多个选择，Valeric 会选择编号最小的篮子。

对于每个足球，输出按照 Valeric 的方案它将被放入的篮子编号。

注意，足球是按照编号递增的顺序放入篮子的，也就是说，先放入第一个足球，然后是第二个足球，依此类推。

## 输入格式

第一行包含两个用空格分隔的整数 $*n*$、$*m*$ $(1 ≤ *n*, *m* ≤ 10^{5})$——足球和篮子的数量。

## 输出格式

输出 $*n*$ 个数字，每行一个。第 $*i*$ 行必须包含第 $*i*$ 个足球所放入的篮子编号。
